title: CLI status
current: On a machine that has not run setup (no machine config, or only the installer's machine id and distribution settings, with no connection or GitHub access), yoke status reports one machine_not_set_up issue whose hint is Run `yoke setup`; it omits env, path and project-mapping issues that setup itself resolves. The folder line reads checkout: only when the folder has .git; any other folder shows folder: <path> (not a git checkout). Engine commands such as yoke projects list, yoke items list and yoke db read refuse the same way, with machine_not_set_up and Run `yoke setup`, unless YOKE_PG_DSN, YOKE_PG_DSN_FILE or YOKE_DB_SECRET_ARN names a database.
